purpose: Keep each layer independently replaceable, traceable and cacheable while preserving one source/key lineage.
cache_rules: reuse L0-L2 when source digest, geometry digest and semantic rule-set digest are unchanged
reuse individual L3-L6 artifact when its own input digests and preset/recipe are unchanged
never reuse L7 if any contributing L3-L6 artifact changed
source or geometry change invalidates all downstream artifacts
annotation change does not invalidate AI atmosphere unless annotation was part of the AI input
failure_isolation: A failed view-specific layer must not force re-extraction of source geometry or semantic state.
